title: International Admissions - Iscrizioni internazionali | Sapienza Università di Roma
blocks: Information in English and Italian for international students wishing to enroll / Informazioni in inglese e italiano per studenti internazionali che vogliono iscriversi

If you are an international student, applying from abroad or holding foreign qualifications, wishing to enroll in one of our many programmes, you must follow different procedures depending on whether you hold an EU or non-EU passport, need a visa, or are already living in Italy.

The webpage International Student Office explains in detail what you need to do depending on your status, programme, and qualifications, with contacts directing you to the office or online service that best fits your needs.
Please remember: Italian candidates with a foreign qualification must follow all procedures as set for International students.
Bachelor's and Master's degrees taught in English
If you want to enroll in a degree programme taught entirely in English, you have to apply for an admission evaluation directly from home through our online pre-selection procedure.
Ready to check all the details, academic entry requirements, deadlines, and scholarship opportunities?
Bachelor's and Master's degrees taught in Italian
If you want to enroll as an international student in a degree programme taught in Italian, please read the procedures on the International Student Office page.

The Sapienza University Foundation Year was conceived for international students who need to complete their basic education in order to pass an admission test in Italian state universities (in a range of disciplines, i.e. Medicine, Architecture, Science, Engineering and Humanities).
